text:
87 million credits. That is what the Ninefold Stadium roof cost to build. It spans 212 meters.

Kaito Brennan designed it. Marisol Achterberg, Chair of the Ninefold Stadium Development Authority, confirmed Brennan as lead roof designer. The design was unveiled on 14 March 2019 at the stadium's official design announcement.

The specifications are set out in the Ninefold Stadium Structural Design Dossier (Revision C), which the Authority formally ratified at its public board session.

**What it means for the sector:** A named lead designer, a ratified dossier and a published cost give contractors and investors a clear benchmark for long-span roof projects. Expect the 87 million credit figure to be cited in future tenders and budget comparisons.
